_help: Rules of tools/lint_srt.py. Edit freely: the tool reads this file every time.
rule: id (unique), severity (error | warn | info), pattern (Python regex, tested on the cue text, lines joined with a newline),
flags ('i' = ignore case, default; use '' for case sensitive), message, enabled (false to switch it off).
limits: numeric checks on the real timing. severity and value can be changed, enabled=false switches one off.
Known false positives can be silenced in <scene folder>/lint.ignore.txt: one line per case, '<rule-id> <HH:MM:SS>' (prefix of the cue start time).
The rules come from STYLE-GUIDE.md (sections 1, 3 and 8).

max_cps.message: reading speed above 20 cps (the post-processing adds 0.3 s / 1 s minimum, so look at the real audio timing)

target_cps.message: reading speed above the 17 cps target

orphan_last_line.message: last line is a single word (orphan)

repeats.message: 'cum' keeps coming back: vary (finish, let go, shoot, blow, give in, lose it, juice, 'already?', 'close?')
'boobs' repeated: use 'them' / drop the noun sometimes
'cock' repeated: use 'it' / an agency variant sometimes

rules.message: adverbial 'lots' (touch me lots, service you lots) reads as non-native English (user rule): use so much / a lot / more / all over / closely / plenty. 'lots of X' and 'lots more' are fine
no written laugh (Hehe, Haha...): user rule, drop it (keep a trailing "Mm..." if needed)
flat translation of すごい/やばい: prefer 'insane', 'too much', 'oh god', 'unstoppable', 'something else' (8)
'properly' (ちゃんと) is a red flag for a stiff translation: restructure (8)

rules.pattern: \b(cum|come|lie back|moan|touch|kiss|feel good|get turned on|get hard|shoot|let it out) for me\b
rules.message: no 'for me' on requests unless 私のために is said (8)
だめ/やめて during arousal = overload: use "I can't--" / "Too much" (8). Ignore if it is a real refusal
never 'he/him' for the cock: use 'your cock' / 'it' (2). Ignore if it is really a third person
use ASCII '--' and '-', never an em/en dash (3)
no parentheticals or sound tags in subtitles (3)

rules.pattern: \b(quite|rather|definitely|i wonder if|would you like to|after all|as expected|stiff|climax)\b
rules.message: words to avoid (1): plain, short, concrete words

rules.pattern: ,\s*(isn't it|don't you think|aren't you|aren't i|doesn't it|wasn't it|isn't that right)\?
rules.message: clunky tag tail: bake the nuance into the clause or use a short tag (8)
avoid 'the X you love so much' (1)
filler word: keep only if the Japanese has the word (ちゃえ -> just, なんか -> kinda, まあ -> well, も -> even) (8)
'your favorite boobs' reads awkwardly (the user never understood it): 大好きな can be dropped, or restructure (1)
vary やばい/すごい: 'oh god', 'insane', 'too much'... (8)
